info.title: Food Ordering API
info.description:
Accounts and authentication for the Food Ordering backend.

**Tokens.** Every login, verified sign-up, and refresh returns an `accessToken` (15 minutes) and a
`refreshToken` (1 day, rotated on every use). Send the access token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
When a request returns 401 `InvalidTokenError`, call `POST /auth/refresh` once and retry.

**Errors** have the shape `{ "error": "...", "message": "..." }`, sometimes with `fields`,
`signInMethod`, or `attemptsLeft`. The two Google routes answer their own failures with `{ "message": "..." }`.

**Email codes** are not emailed yet: the server prints them to its console.

get.description: Liveness only; does not touch the database.

post.description:
Validates the details and emails a 6-digit code (valid 10 minutes). No account exists until
`/auth/register/verify` succeeds. Registering again with the same email replaces the waiting sign-up.

Rate limits: 10 per hour per IP, 5 per hour per email.

202.description: Code sent. In development it is printed to the server console.

value.message: We sent a 6-digit code to your email.

400.description: Invalid body. `fields` names every invalid field.

value.message: Some fields are invalid.
The request body must be valid JSON of at most 10 KB.

409.description: The email already has an account. `signInMethod` says how to log in.

value.message: This email is already registered. Log in with your email and password.
This email is already registered with Google. Use Continue with Google.
Too many sign-up attempts for this email. Try again later.

503.description: Server is missing a secret in its configuration.

value.message: Set OTP_SECRET_KEY in .env, then restart.

post.description:
Replaces the code and resets the wrong-code count. Allowed once every 60 seconds.

Rate limits: 10 per hour per IP, 5 per hour per email.

202.description: Code sent. In development it is printed to the server console.

value.message: We sent a new code to your email.

400.description: Invalid email, or no sign-up waiting.

value.message: No sign-up is waiting for this email. Register again.

value.message: Wait 42 seconds before asking for another code.
Too many code requests for this email. Try again later.

post.summary: Log in with email and password
post.description:
Creates a new session for this device; other devices stay logged in.

Rate limits: 20 per 15 minutes per IP, 5 failed per 15 minutes per email.

400.description: Invalid body. `fields` names every invalid field.

value.message: Some fields are invalid.
The request body must be valid JSON of at most 10 KB.

401.description: Unknown email or wrong password (same answer for both).

value.message: Invalid email or password.

403.description: Correct password, but the account is disabled.

value.message: This account is disabled.

409.description: The email belongs to a Google account.

value.message: This email is already registered with Google. Use Continue with Google.
Too many failed logins for this email. Try again later.

post.description:
Checks the current password, sets the new one, keeps this device logged in, ends every other
session, and emails the owner. The current tokens keep working. No email code is needed: the
current password is the proof (use the Forgot password flow if it is unknown).

A wrong current password is a 400 on `fields.currentPassword`, never a 401, so clients do not
mistake it for an expired token.

Rate limits: 20 per 15 minutes per IP, 5 wrong current passwords per 15 minutes per user.

204.description: Password changed. Other devices are signed out.

400.description: Invalid body. `fields` names every invalid field.

value.message: Some fields are invalid.
The request body must be valid JSON of at most 10 KB.

401.description: Missing, invalid, or expired access token, or the session has ended.

value.message: Missing authentication token, please login first
The provided token is invalid or expired, please login first
Your session has ended. Log in again.

409.description: A Google account (no password), or the password changed during the request.

value.message: This account signs in with Google, so it has no password to change.
Your password changed while this request was running. Try again.
Too many wrong current passwords. Try again later.

post.description:
Always answers 202 with the same body, so it never reveals which emails have accounts.
Active password accounts get a 6-digit code (valid 10 minutes); Google accounts get a reminder to
use Continue with Google; unknown or disabled accounts get nothing. Asking again within 60 seconds
sends nothing new: use the code already sent.

Rate limits: 10 per hour per IP, 5 per hour per email.

202.description: Code sent. In development it is printed to the server console.

value.message: If this email has a password account, we sent it a code.

400.description: Invalid body. `fields` names every invalid field.

value.message: Some fields are invalid.
The request body must be valid JSON of at most 10 KB.
Too many password reset requests for this email. Try again later.

post.summary: Exchange the code for a reset token
post.description:
Every failure (wrong, expired, or used-up code, or an email without a code) gets the same 400.
Five wrong codes end the code. On success the code is used up.

Rate limit: 30 per 15 minutes per IP.

200.description: Code accepted. Send the reset token to `/auth/password/reset` within 10 minutes.

400.description: The code is not valid, or the body is invalid.

value.message: This code is wrong or has expired.
Some fields are invalid.

fields.code: Enter the 6-digit code from the email.

value.message: Too many code attempts from your network. Try again later.

post.summary: Set the new password and log in
post.description:
Sets the new password, marks the email as verified, ends every session on every device, and logs
this device in. The reset token works once.

Rate limit: 10 per 15 minutes per IP.

400.description: Invalid body, or the reset token is invalid, expired, or already used.

value.message: This password reset has expired. Ask for a new code.
Some fields are invalid.
Too many password resets from your network. Try again later.

post.description:
Returns a new access token and a new refresh token. The refresh token you sent stops working.

Rate limit: 60 per 15 minutes per IP.

400.description: Invalid body. `fields` names every invalid field.

value.message: Some fields are invalid.

value.message: The request body must be valid JSON of at most 10 KB.

value.message: Your session has ended. Log in again.
Too many refresh attempts from your network. Try again later.

post.description: Deletes every session of the user. All access and refresh tokens stop working immediately.

get.description: Redirects to Google and sets an `oauth_browser` cookie. Open this URL in a browser; after you pick an account, Google sends you to `/auth/google/callback`, which shows the session JSON. Copy `accessToken` and `refreshToken` from there.

value.message: Could not start authorization. Try again.
Set OAUTH_CLIENT_ID and OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET in .env, then restart.

get.description: Called by Google, not by you. Needs the cookie set by `/auth/google` in the same browser.

200.description: Logged in to an existing account.

201.description: First Google login: account created and logged in.

400.description: Unknown, used, or expired attempt; or Google returned no code.

value.message: Invalid or expired attempt. Start again at /auth/google.
Could not verify the Google identity. Start again at /auth/google.

403.description: New account, but the Google email is not verified; or the account is disabled.

value.message: Your Google account's email is not verified, so it cannot be used to create an account.
This account is disabled.

409.description: The email belongs to another account.

value.message: This email is registered with a password. Log in with your email and password.
Token exchange failed. Check the client settings and start again at /auth/google.

email.description: Trimmed and lowercased by the server.

phone.description: Optional. International format; spaces, dashes, and brackets are removed.
